axes.gltf: Right-handed Y-up, exporter conversion verified by reimport, no manual corrective rotation

extension_fallback: KHR_materials_emissive_strength is optional. Core emissive/base-color factors remain; emission-off coupon was reviewed.

exporter.execution: Blender main-thread disposable process; generated export copy only

limitations: Runtime integration/performance not tested; no SMILE runtime, importer, renderer or compiler changes.
Four lift cabins have measured upper/lower review states and neutral anchors; functioning elevators and collision updates are not implemented.
Hangar door panels retain individual pivots and open/closed placements; no runtime control or exported animation clips.
L1/L2 optional LODs not implemented. One canonical GLB serves preview and L0.
Materials use plain PBR factors and real geometry, with no textures, UV trim-sheet layout or baked texture maps. Opaque teal is the portable baseline.

Collision is a separate Blender collection of 379 local solids/rail segments, with cabins at upper stops. It is not a supported-runtime-format claim; ground floor proxy differences up to 0.012m remain within the specified 0.02m seam tolerance.
Architecture uses a clean repeated bay treatment with simplified micro-ornament; it is not a pixel-identical recreation of the concept illustrations.
Phone visibility of inline chat images remains unconfirmed; all original PNGs are retained locally.
path_base: Workspace root, the parent directory of export/
